question_text: Which demo booth attracted bigger crowds — NVIDIA or Intel? Roughly how much more popular was the winner?
answer_text: The NVIDIA demo booth attracted bigger crowds than the Intel booth. NVIDIA was roughly 116.8 more popular in terms of crowd size.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch_nvidia:CrowdHour)
WHERE ch_nvidia.camera_location CONTAINS 'NVIDIA' 
  AND ch_nvidia.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' 
  AND ch_nvidia.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH SUM(ch_nvidia.avg_hc) AS total_nvidia_crowd

MATCH (ch_intel:CrowdHour)
WHERE ch_intel.camera_location CONTAINS 'Intel' 
  AND ch_intel.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' 
  AND ch_intel.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH total_nvidia_crowd, SUM(ch_intel.avg_hc) AS total_intel_crowd

RETURN 
  CASE 
    WHEN total_nvidia_crowd > total_intel_crowd THEN 'NVIDIA'
    ELSE 'Intel'
  END AS more_popular_booth,
  ABS(total_nvidia_crowd - total_intel_crowd) AS difference_in_crowd
